extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news:
1.0.71: Honor the MKGA.TV Auto translate preference for both cloud and BYOK playback paths, keep original subtitles when translation is off, and handle empty embedded-only subtitle results safely.
1.0.70: Restore the proven two-press Back/Exit guard.
1.0.62: Faster Home refresh with cursor-safe infinite catalogs, incremental row patching, and background-only account/library/CW maintenance.
1.0.61: Add stale-while-revalidate Streams SQLite v2 and idle Continue Watching stream prefetch for faster source opening.
1.0.60: Fix Stremio 1ms next-episode pointers and avoid false finished-series state when metadata is incomplete.
1.0.59: Fix Continue Watching regression: remove watched/90%+ movies, keep completed series hidden until an aired next episode is verified, and rebuild the SQLite CW index automatically.
1.0.58: SQLite-backed Continue Watching for all series, MKGA server-side subtitle resolver/cloud cache, Noiro-style fast subtitle translation path, and Kodi API networking fixes.
1.0.57: Remove Premium UI, add MKGA subtitle sync status/Sync Now, and support Orange subtitle color from MKGA.TV.
1.0.56: Make MKGA.TV Account the recommended subtitle settings source while preserving a full This device - Local fallback and keeping Gemini keys local.
1.0.55: Sync MKGA.TV subtitle preferences in the background, including language priority, AI behavior and Kodi subtitle style.
1.0.51: Prevent legacy-profile migration failures from blocking startup/sign-in, and add an optional native Kodi Search keyboard for Yatse/Kore and physical/Bluetooth keyboard users.

extension.summary: Pair Kodi with your MKGA.TV account
extension.description: Securely pair this Kodi device with MKGA.TV so you can install and maintain approved MKGA repositories and addons from your account.

extension.summary: Install and update MKGA Kodi add-ons
extension.description: Official MKGA.TV Kodi repository for Stremio for Kodi, MKGA Connector and future MKGA add-ons.
extension.news:
1.1.0: Renamed to MKGA Repository and added MKGA Connector alongside Stremio for Kodi.
1.0.2: Make repository transport flags explicit for Kodi clients and refresh the stable feed installer.
1.0.1: Dark Cinematic icon, background and in-Kodi previews. Repository feed now serves every declared artwork asset.
